## Outcome

The renderer cleanup merged, two CI proposals closed without merge, and multiline facet work was updated against current upstream changes.

## Context

PR #306 began before GSoC. This week completed its focused review and merge without expanding it into a behavior change.

## What I Did

- Merged [PR #306](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/306) on June 29, removing unnecessary `Selectors.hasOwnProperty()` guards while preserving existing selector behavior.
- Closed [PR #338](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/338) without merge.
- Closed [PR #341](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/341) without merge.
- Updated [PR #339](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/339) with current upstream changes.
- Reviewed the remaining midterm set: #285, #286, #288, #336, and #339.

## Learnings

Repository progress is not only a merge count. One safe cleanup landed, two investigations stopped at the correct boundary, and one feature branch remained current. Closing a patch after learning its solution belongs elsewhere is better than carrying an unnecessary change into the main branch.

## Challenges / Notes

Closing work after a detailed investigation can feel disappointing. The stronger measure is whether the repository, issue history, and next decision are clearer afterward.

## Next Week Targets

Use the midterm checkpoint to separate remaining implementation needs from review cleanup.
